frontier.hypothesis: dx's INSN_PRIORITY can be raised above az's while the candidate's statement order (which already yields the target's seats) is left untouched, which is the only axis that moves sched1 without moving LUIDs.
frontier.mechanism: rank_for_schedule tests INSN_PRIORITY before it falls through to INSN_LUID. All six subus are priority 1 only because every operand is computed in an earlier block; if one of dx's operands were produced inside block 7 by an insn whose result_ready_cost is greater than 1 (a load: priority(dx) = 1 + 2 - 1 = 2), dx would outrank az in the ready list and be scheduled first with the source order unchanged, preserving dx's 6-insn live range and therefore its $v1 seat.
frontier.next_probe: Find a spelling in which the vertex-2 x load (or the vertex-0 x load) lands inside the test-3 block without adding an instruction -- e.g. read that coordinate through the object at its test-3 use site while the test-2 use keeps the local -- and read tmp/grind/func_8002D780/dumps/code6cac_b.cse and .combine to see whether the second read survives as its own load or is folded back to the earlier pseudo. build_insns must stay 202: if the earlier load remains live for test 2 the body goes to 203 and the probe is dead.

frontier.hypothesis: The qty_compare_1 tie can be broken from the n_refs side by a fourth reference to dx whose other uses stay inside block 7, without merging a cross-block quantity into dx as batch N's kp carrier did.
frontier.mechanism: floor_log2 steps at 4 references, so a fourth in-block reference more than doubles dx's qty priority (3 -> 8 in the numerator) while the live length grows at most from 7 to 10. Batch N failed not on the arithmetic but because kp is defined in all three side tests, so carrying it in dx merged a multi-block quantity and cost more at the join than the seat was worth.
frontier.next_probe: From tmp/grind/func_8002D780/s6/dumpsA/lreg.txt enumerate the block-7 values that die before dx is born or are born after dx dies (ax dies at the first mult, az at the second, and the kc subtraction is born two insns after dx dies); the kc subtraction is the only carrier whose uses are all inside block 7 and it was never measured (batch N's n6 carried kc in az, not in dx). Measure the kc-in-dx carrier against the candidate and h1 statement orders.

frontier.hypothesis: A decomp-permuter campaign on the 2-floor chassis finds the last two instructions where the s4 campaign on the 7-floor chassis found nothing.
frontier.mechanism: The s4 campaign's neighbourhood was dominated by residuals B and C, which no local rearrangement could reach. With those closed, s6 has shown the remainder to be a single local-alloc tie over two adjacent subtractions -- squarely inside the permuter's statement-reordering and temporary-introduction pass set.
frontier.next_probe: Regenerate base.c from memory/grind/func_8002D780/candidate.c into the validated workspace tmp/grind/func_8002D780/s4/nonmatchings/func_8002D780 (four hurdles + rebuild recipe in evidence.md [s4]), launch with tools/permuter_campaign.py, wait IN-TURN with 'permuter_campaign.py wait --dir <ws>', harvest with --stop before the turn ends, and re-score every find on the engine sandbox -- the s4 finding that the permuter's weighted metric is anti-correlated with the engine's on this function still applies. The body's family classification (unspent s5 frontier item) must still be settled before any candidate-ready submission.
